messages:
mia_cs: FYI — Orchard Health just told me their Analytics org is launching a new Insights team next month and wants us onboarded. They expect ~3x embeddings QPS and higher realtime summarization traffic. flagging for capacity + enablement :wave:
alex_am: Nice — any numbers yet? and is this full prod or a pilot?
mia_cs: Olivia said pilot -> prod if latency/cost look good. Current pilot qps ~150 embeddings, target prod ~450 peaks. also more small chat requests for summarization (200->600 rps).
raj_se: Sounds like a throughput + latency concern. Recommend reserved pods for the Insights team during ramp. can we get their request in a ticket?
olivia_orchard: Yes — that's correct. We're running internal POCs this month, hoping to go live end of next quarter. Priority is low-latency similarity search and nightly batch reranks.
ops-bot: Ticket #CS-8421 created for Orchard Health — capacity request logged and assigned to eng-ops.
alex_am: From an account health + renewal perspective, this is a strong expansion signal but also a risk if perf/cost don't meet expectations. Recommend 1) short enablement session for their infra/ML owners, 2) canary dedicated capacity for first 2 weeks, 3) sample caching config + quantization suggestions.
mia_cs: Agreed. I'll own the enablement call and collect their current prompt sets. can someone from SEs prepare a quick playbook?
raj_se: I'll draft a playbook. plan to include: prefix/KV caching, batch sizing, recommended quantization tiers, and a small eval harness they can run locally. snippet for their team to request quota bump:
```
Quota request: {
  customer: "Orchard Health",
  embeddings_qps_current: 150,
  embeddings_qps_target: 450,
  summarization_rps_current: 200,
  summarization_rps_target: 600,
  start_date: "2026-04-15"
}
```
olivia_orchard: That format works. Also, can you include guidance on cost tradeoffs? Our finance team will sign off only if we can demonstrate <20% token-cost growth.
alex_am: We'll include cost simulations in the playbook — run 3 configs: hosted + caching, dedicated with standard quant, dedicated with aggressive quant.
mia_cs: Meeting scheduled with Orchard Insights leads for Tue 09:30 PT. I'll send calendar invite and prompt set beforehand.
ops-bot: Canary capacity proposal deployed to staging. Monitoring hooks for latency and error-rate added.
raj_se: Action items: 1) SE playbook draft by Fri (raj_se) 2) cost sims by Mon (alex_am) 3) enablement call (mia_cs) 4) engineering to approve temporary reserved pods (eng-ops) — tagging eng-ops in ticket.
olivia_orchard: Appreciate it — we'll share sample prompts and an eval set after the enablement call. also, quick feedback: the docs on batching are good but we found KV cache examples sparse. please include a runnable example.
mia_cs: Noted — we'll include runnable KV cache example and a short recorded demo.
alex_am: One more thing: renewal for Orchard is due in 7 months. If expansion goes well, potential uplift of 2x ARR. if performance issues appear during ramp, that becomes a renewal risk. Let's treat this as high-priority expansion play. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
mia_cs: Agreed. I'll track health signals post-call and post-canary (latency P95, error rate, unit cost delta). Will post status updates in this thread. :rocket:
